run_cifar10_models: run a CIFAR10 models experiment with resnet34 architecture and standard augmentation from scratch
run_cifar10_baseline: run a CIFAR10 baseline fine-tuning experiment in normal mode with 50 epochs
run_cifar10_conformal_training: run a CIFAR10 conformal training sub-experiment with threshold_logp method and normal size loss
run_cifar10_group_zero: run a CIFAR10 conformal group_zero sub-experiment sweeping loss_matrix values for group zero classes
run_cifar10_class_size: run a CIFAR10 conformal class_size sub-experiment sweeping size_weights for a selected class
